summary.goal: Extend ConfigWriter to generate IdeationConfig from baselines, gated by stability controls. Periodic regeneration.

acceptance_criteria.description: generateIdeationConfig() returns DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG when no baselines exist (zero data)
Confidence calibration: confident_value adjusted downward (min 70) when mean_questions_per_plan > 3 AND stability check passes
Specialist spawning: specialists with < 20% contribution rate added to deprioritized list when stability check passes
Readiness advisory: min_conversation_turns set to floor(mean_conversation_turns), clamped [3, 15]
Readiness advisory: min_specialist_coverage set to count of specialists with > 50% contribution rate, clamped [1, 4]
Every config change path goes through StabilityControls.checkStability() with ideation-specific parameter types
Config regenerated every 6 hours (ideation changes are slow)
saveConfig() persists ideation_config alongside forge_config and planner_config in config_versions

steps.title: Add generateIdeationConfig method to ConfigWriter
steps.description: Extend packages/tuner/src/services/config-writer.ts with generateIdeationConfig() method. Returns defaults when no baselines, applies learning when stability controls pass.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns DEFAULT_IDEATION_CONFIG when baseline is null or sample_count === 0
Retrieves baseline via this.storage.getIdeationBaseline('session_quality')
Increments version and sets updated_at timestamp

steps.title: Implement confidence calibration logic
steps.description: In generateIdeationConfig, adjust confident_value downward when mean_questions_per_plan > 3, gated by stability check for ideation_confidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Calls stabilityControls.checkStability({ parameterType: 'ideation_confidence', totalTrials: baseline.sample_count, ... })
Only adjusts if stabilityCheck.canChange (stability controls use standard burn-in=50)
If mean_questions_per_plan > 3, reduce confident_value proportionally (e.g., Math.round(mean_questions * 2))
confident_value never goes below 70

architecture.logic: If plans still need many clarification questions despite high block confidence, the threshold is too generous. Lower it.

steps.title: Implement specialist deprioritization logic
steps.description: In generateIdeationConfig, build deprioritized list from specialists with < 20% contribution rate, gated by stability check for ideation_spawning

acceptance_criteria.description: Calls stabilityControls.checkStability({ parameterType: 'ideation_spawning', ... })
Only updates if stabilityCheck.canChange
Iterates baseline.specialist_contribution_rates, adds to deprioritized if rate < 0.20
Requires min_samples_per_arm (30, standard threshold) sessions before deprioritizing

architecture.logic: Specialists that rarely contribute useful content are deprioritized (not blocked, just advisory)

steps.title: Implement readiness advisory thresholds
steps.description: In generateIdeationConfig, set min_conversation_turns and min_specialist_coverage from baselines, gated by stability check for ideation_readiness

acceptance_criteria.description: Calls stabilityControls.checkStability({ parameterType: 'ideation_readiness', ... })
Only updates if stabilityCheck.canChange
min_conversation_turns = Math.max(3, Math.min(15, Math.floor(baseline.mean_conversation_turns)))
min_specialist_coverage = count of specialists with contribution rate > 0.50, clamped [1, 4]

architecture.logic: Set advisory thresholds based on observed patterns that correlate with lower downstream question counts

steps.title: Add getCurrentIdeationConfig method
steps.description: In ConfigWriter, add getCurrentIdeationConfig() that returns cached config or generates fresh one

acceptance_criteria.description: Checks latest config_version for ideation_config
Returns cached if present, otherwise calls generateIdeationConfig()
Follows same pattern as getCurrentForgeConfig / getCurrentPlannerConfig

architecture.pattern: Cached read with fallback to generate

steps.title: Extend saveConfig to persist ideation_config
steps.description: Modify saveConfig(forgeConfig, plannerConfig, notes?) to accept optional ideationConfig parameter and persist to config_versions.ideation_config

acceptance_criteria.description: Signature: saveConfig(forge, planner, ideation?, notes?)
Calls storage.insertConfigVersion with all three configs
ideation_config column stores JSON.stringify(ideationConfig) or NULL

steps.title: Add periodic config regeneration
steps.description: In server.ts or factory.ts, add setInterval to regenerate configs every 6 hours, including ideation config

acceptance_criteria.description: setInterval with 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000 ms interval
Calls generateIdeationConfig(), getCurrentForgeConfig(), getCurrentPlannerConfig()
Calls saveConfig(forge, planner, ideation, 'periodic regeneration')
Errors logged but don't crash server

steps.title: Test config generation logic
steps.description: Unit tests for generateIdeationConfig covering all learning paths and stability gates

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns defaults when baseline is null
Returns defaults when sample_count < 20 (burn-in)
Adjusts confident_value when mean_questions > 3 and stability check passes
Does NOT adjust confident_value when stability check blocks (cool-down, CI width, etc.)
Builds deprioritized list correctly from contribution rates
Sets readiness thresholds within clamped ranges
